        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>平台：rk3576</p>
<p>方案：原生bt1120 tx接nvp6021芯片 转为ahd信号 接ahd显示屏幕</p>
<h1>1、硬件确认</h1>
<h2>&nbsp;1.1 rk3576 bt1120硬件确认</h2>
<p>&nbsp;　　查阅硬件设计指南可以确认 rk3576是支持 16bit bt1120模式 ，最高支持1080p60Hz。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260604142810233-1601125670.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 对应引脚可以查阅引脚设计指南或者设备树pinctrl ，bt1120只有这些引脚，如下图所示：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260604142532836-937162036.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>1.2、nvp6021硬件确认</h2>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;　&nbsp; 电源，有供电引脚控制需要开启，并测了一下是否正常。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260604144324208-345808032.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　 复位：这里是active low ，因为使用硬件原理图上加了三极管，需要取反处理</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260604144458553-317092067.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　 I2C地址及电平，使用i2c的电平必须为3v3或者转为3v3的。　　</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260604174043459-2056424306.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260604174203719-1496686371.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1>2、驱动及设备树配置</h1>
<h2>　　2.1、nvp6021驱动实现</h2>
<p>　　nvp6021厂家是没有提供Linux版本驱动的，只提供一个1080P_720P5060_74.25MHz_16bit_20191213.txt这种寄存器配置，根据这个配置结合设备树简单实现对应分辨率及帧数选择。</p>
<p>　　<span class="ne-text">通过设备树nextchip,vmode 属性来选择对应寄存器写入。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>nvp6021: nvp6021@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> { 
        pinctrl</span>-names = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        pinctrl</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> = &lt;&amp;nvp6021_rst_pins&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        compatible </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nextchip,nvp6021</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        reg </span>= &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x30</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        reset</span>-gpios = &lt;&amp;gpio3 RK_PD4 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; 
        nextchip,vmode </span>= &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 0:1080p30, 1:1080p25, 2:720p60, 3:720p50 </span>
    };</pre>
</div>
<p>　　实现的驱动源码，复位引脚电平会导致寄存器是否正常写入，以实际硬件为准。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * NVP6021 AHD TX initialization driver (I2C only)
 *
 * Supports video modes:
 *   0 = 1080p30
 *   1 = 1080p25
 *   2 = 720p60
 *   3 = 720p50
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

#include </span>&lt;linux/module.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;linux/i2c.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;linux/gpio/consumer.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;linux/delay.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;linux/of.h&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#include </span>&lt;linux/property.h&gt;

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Video mode defines (matching original DecoderInitial) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> NVP6021_VMODE_1080P30  0
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> NVP6021_VMODE_1080P25  1
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> NVP6021_VMODE_720P60   2
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> NVP6021_VMODE_720P50   3

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nvp6021_priv {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> i2c_client *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> gpio_desc   *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">reset_gpio;
    u8                  vmode;
};

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Write one byte to register address </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> nvp6021_write(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> i2c_client *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client, u8 reg, u8 val)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i2c_smbus_write_byte_data(client, reg, val);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Hardware reset sequence (exactly as original) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> nvp6021_hw_reset(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> nvp6021_priv *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">priv)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!priv-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">reset_gpio) {
        dev_warn(</span>&amp;priv-&gt;client-&gt;dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No reset GPIO, skip reset\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    
    gpiod_set_value_cansleep(priv</span>-&gt;reset_gpio, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    usleep_range(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2000</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    gpiod_set_value_cansleep(priv</span>-&gt;reset_gpio, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    usleep_range(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20000</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">21000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    gpiod_set_value_cansleep(priv</span>-&gt;reset_gpio, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    usleep_range(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5000</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Full initialization sequence based on the given code </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> nvp6021_initialize(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> nvp6021_priv *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">priv)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> i2c_client *client = priv-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client;
    u8 vmode </span>= priv-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vmode;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret;

    dev_info(</span>&amp;client-&gt;dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Initializing NVP6021 (vmode=%d)\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, vmode);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Hardware reset </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    nvp6021_hw_reset(priv);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---- BANK0 ---- </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xFF</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span>);    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> select BANK0</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;
    ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (vmode) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_1080P30:
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xF0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x04</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">ret = nvp6021_write(client, 0x04, 0x85);</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_1080P25:
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xF1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x04</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_720P60:
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xE2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x04</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_720P50:
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xE3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;
        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x04</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        dev_err(</span>&amp;client-&gt;dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Invalid vmode %d\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, vmode);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EINVAL;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---- BANK1 ---- </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xFF</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span>);    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> select BANK1</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;
    ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x0E</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ---- BANK2 (main configuration) ---- </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xFF</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x02</span>);    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> select BANK2</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Write the sequence exactly as provided </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    u8 init_vals[][</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xFE</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x02</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x04</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x80</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x05</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x06</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x10</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x0C</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x04</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x0D</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x3F</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x0E</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x10</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xEB</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x11</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x10</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x12</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xF0</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x13</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x14</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x01</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x15</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x16</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span>}, {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x17</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},

        ret </span>= nvp6021_write(client, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x37</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xB0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (ret) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">goto</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> err;

    dev_info(</span>&amp;client-&gt;dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NVP6021 initialization completed successfully\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">return 0;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">ret = nvp6021_write(client, 0xFF, 0x02);  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保选择 BANK2
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">if (ret) goto err;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">ret = nvp6021_write(client, 0x04, 0x81);  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 0x04 的 bit7 置 1 使能彩条输出
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">if (ret) goto err;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    dev_info(</span>&amp;client-&gt;dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NVP6021 initialization done (color bar test enabled)\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

err:
    dev_err(</span>&amp;client-&gt;dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">I2C write failed\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Probe - called when device is found on I2C bus </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> nvp6021_probe(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> i2c_client *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">client,
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> i2c_device_id *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">id)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> device *dev = &amp;client-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dev;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> nvp6021_priv *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">priv;
    u32 vmode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_1080P30;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret;

    priv </span>= devm_kzalloc(dev, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span>(*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">priv), GFP_KERNEL);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">priv)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ENOMEM;

    priv</span>-&gt;client =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client;
    i2c_set_clientdata(client, priv);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Obtain reset GPIO (active high as in original) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    priv</span>-&gt;reset_gpio = devm_gpiod_get_optional(dev, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">reset</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, GPIOD_OUT_LOW);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (IS_ERR(priv-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">reset_gpio))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> dev_err_probe(dev, PTR_ERR(priv-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">reset_gpio),
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to get reset GPIO\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Read video mode from device tree property </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    device_property_read_u32(dev, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nextchip,vmode</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vmode);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (vmode &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_720P50) {
        dev_warn(dev, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Invalid vmode %u, fallback to 1080p30\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, vmode);
        vmode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NVP6021_VMODE_1080P30;
    }
    priv</span>-&gt;vmode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (u8)vmode;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Run initialization sequence </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ret </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nvp6021_initialize(priv);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ret)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ret;

    dev_info(dev, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NVP6021 driver probe successful\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> of_device_id nvp6021_of_match[] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {

    nvp6021_rst {
        nvp6021_rst_pins: nvp6021_rst_pins {
            rockchip,pins </span>= &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> RK_PD4 RK_FUNC_GPIO &amp;pcfg_pull_none&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        };
    };
};</span></pre>
</div>
<h1>&nbsp;3、调试与测试</h1>
<p>　　查看当前屏幕的显示状态：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cat /sys/kernel/debug/dri/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>/summary</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260606092939616-1221242785.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　　使用modetest测试输出彩条</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modetest -M rockchip</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260606093422982-1076785523.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modestet -M rockchip -s  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">168</span>@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">72</span>:192<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x1080</span>　　　　　　</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" width="1210" height="681" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260606093738827-309933212.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　　　能正常输出彩条，屏幕是调通了的。</p>
<p>　　　　 如果输出不太正常 可以尝试抓ahd_out输出波形或者时钟是否正确，这里原厂说波形算下来和1080p30的行时序差不多，具体如果计算并未说明。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260606093947490-1912672641.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　　　暂时还有一个问题未解决，从寄存器配置输出彩条或者从modetest测试都偏暗，测试调整过datasheet 里面, bnak2 0x1d/1e/0x37 没有效果，也测试过调整色域，参考rk色域说明也是没有什么效果。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="1197" height="708" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260606094802122-59015830.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
